summary: No blockers. Scope discipline clean (exactly two files, adopt-side producer correctly untouched). 2 medium findings on the regression test's detection power (unanchored id-reintroduction regex; section-number-keyed retirement patterns) and 8 low findings (dead assertion, docstring cross-reference, Layers-cell inconsistency in the new worked-example rows, truncated cross-reference titles, redundant Optional Sections subsection, redundant test assertions, undocumented intentional test-coverage duplication with the integration-tests root). All 2 medium and 6 of 8 low findings applied before commit; verified by re-running plugins/shipwright-project/tests (64 passed), integration-tests/test_fr_table_shape_convergence.py (13 passed), and the shared/tests spec-generation.md subset (58 passed). The one pre-existing low finding (Required Sections list omitting the optional UI Requirements section from its numbering) was explicitly flagged by the reviewer as pre-existing, not a regression, and left alone per scope discipline.

review.finding: Anti-reintroduction regex required backtick/pipe immediately adjacent to the id, missing a reintroduced `| QR-01.01 |` table row.
review.fix: Unanchored to `QR-\d|\bC-\d`; verified it now catches both `| QR-01.01 |` and `| C-01.01 |`.

review.finding: retired_patterns keyed to section NUMBERS, under-detecting a QR section reintroduced under a different number and over-coupling to the Constraints heading number.
review.fix: Replaced the numbered-heading literal with a number-agnostic regex on heading text; dropped the redundant '## 4. Constraints' literal (already covered by the id-column-absence test).

review.finding: Dead assertion `not any(rid.startswith('QR-') ...)` can never fail by construction of the reader.
review.fix: Replaced with a falsifiable full-set-equality assertion over the active FR ids.

review.finding: Docstring mis-attributed which test pins the single surviving C-{NN} occurrence; two test names/docstrings overlapped in what they claimed to prove.
review.fix: Renamed to test_no_line_mints_a_live_qr_or_c_id with an accurate docstring; renamed the Constraints test to test_constraints_render_as_prose_bullets and dropped its redundant first assertion.

review.finding: Worked-example FR-01.08/.09 Layers cells disagreed with the doc's own stated defaults (a performance target should carry integration+unit; the password-storage FR touches persistence).
review.fix: Both cells now read `unit, integration`; updated the enumeration paragraph to include them among the bare rows.

review.finding: Three cross-references quoted truncated heading titles.
review.fix: Quoted the full heading text ('...Not a Separate Section' / '...Not a Requirement Table') at all three sites.

review.finding: The 'Optional Sections' subsection now held a single bullet restating item 3's own '(if applicable)' qualifier.
review.fix: Removed the subsection; folded its one rule into a plain sentence after the Required Sections list.

review.finding: test_worked_example_still_carries_the_canonical_fr_header duplicates part of integration-tests/test_fr_table_shape_convergence.py with no note on whether that's intentional.
review.fix: Added a docstring note: the plugin's own tests/ root and integration-tests/ never run in the same pytest process (ADR-044), so this plugin keeps its own copy of the invariant deliberately.

review.finding: Required Sections list ends at item 6 (References) while the Template Structure body ends at '## 7. References' (list omits the optional UI Requirements section).
review.fix: Pre-existing off-by-one (was 7 vs 8 before this diff too), preserved exactly by the renumbering. Out of scope for this change per the operator's directive; left as-is.
